notes: Structural bounds only. No wall-clock latency or RSS threshold belongs here until the B0 distributions are pinned (plan, todo 17).
Raising a bound is a deliberate commit, the scripts/ci/check_code_size.py ratchet in the same shape. A regression cannot raise its own ceiling.
Each bound is enforced by scripts/perf/check_structural.py against the STRUCTURAL_PERF lines the repo's own tests print.
context condensation: one generic budget (48 KiB), a one-line notice for an unchanged re-read, and exactly one aging batch per pressure crossing.
irc mailbox: a 100-message cap that drops the oldest, one body allocation per broadcast, no waiter left parked after timeout/cancel churn, and a 16-leg broadcast concurrency ceiling.

skill loading: listing the catalog reads at most one frontmatter prefix per skill (8 KiB each, so a 32 KiB body read whole fails), and a request against an unchanged workspace reads no SKILL.md and lists no skill directory.
